errors.evidence: The chart shows 10 distinct categories, not nine. The description itself proceeds to list all 10 categories and their percentages.

The prompt asks to include the color for each slice. The description makes a general statement that each slice has a different color but fails to specify the color for any of the individual slices (e.g., 'Draft/Other' is dark red, 'Press Release' is yellow).

errors.text_span: The visual design allows for easy comparison of the relative proportions of stimulus types used in journalistic LLM interactions.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides a subjective evaluation of the chart's design quality ('allows for easy comparison'), which is an interpretation rather than an objective description of the visual information, as requested by the prompt.
